key_findings: Oral CB2 agonist COR167 reduced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in SNI mice without tolerance.
COR167 prevented spinal microglial HDAC1 overexpression and NF-kB activation and raised IL-10 via CB2 (AM630-sensitive in BV2 cells).
